items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: We've got an old bass tuba that Chink Martin played on lots of times.

ctx.x: Most of your personal collection is here then, is it?

Well, a great deal of it, but some of the real collector's things I have away, make sure they don't get broken and so forth. And we have some old instruments, as you can see, trombone, clarinet, old trumpets here. We've got an old bass tuba that Chink Martin played on lots of times. And I've got, in the background here, I've got Monk Hazel's mellophone.

Oh, yeah. And we always got... I was going to say, does anybody ever kid you? I notice in your, it looks like you're lined up here for a session almost with a lot of chairs, including two rocking chairs. Does anybody kid you about using some of the old-timers that can't walk anymore have to sit in a rocking chair? Well, I haven't got to that yet. Not yet. Not yet. Very comfortable-looking studio.
